open_questions: Risk: the Danger line is hidden by availability rule dead_danger_meter (never true), so the mining panel shows no risk. Flip the rule (economy-designer) to show it; no code change needed.

Mining cost per unit is the planet's dross_buy / nullglass_buy price (existing mechanic).
